nodes.label: Test Frame 00289 - Near-Duplicate of Frame 00097, +12 Seconds (IPC-Siren, 2022-02-26 23:11:28)
nodes.description: Colour overhead still from the same camera, same day and same minute as test frame 00097, exactly twelve seconds later. Scene geometry, lighting, feed level in the pans and litter pattern are essentially identical; only the birds have shifted, having vacated more of the lower-centre floor and compacted further toward the top of the frame. Feed is still visible in all five pans.
nodes.rationale: Nearly all image content is shared with frame 00097, so the two frames are not statistically independent evaluation samples despite carrying different filenames.

nodes.label: Temporal Near-Duplicate Frames Within the Test Split
nodes.description: Distinct test-set filenames that are in fact samples from the same short video window: frames 00097 and 00289 are twelve seconds apart on 2022-02-26 at 23:11, sharing identical lighting, feed level, litter pattern and camera geometry, and differing only in individual bird positions.
nodes.rationale: Sampling stills at a rate faster than the scene decorrelates makes the effective test-set size far smaller than the file count suggests, inflating apparent accuracy and shrinking confidence intervals; frames should be grouped by recording window before evaluation.
